name: Rexxar’s Drakefire Amulet

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

summary: Back with Rexxar, the adventurers receive the Drakefire Amulet. The token bears the protection gathered from every trial and opens the way before them. The Horde has come to this gate by a road all its own: through intelligence, Eitrigg’s counsel, Thrall’s word, Rexxar’s charge and a dragon’s blood. At the mountain’s foot, that labor gives way to a final descent.
